svg.title: Makalu — mountain relief
svg.desc: Western summit pyramid above the Barun glacier. Four-sided summit pyramid, exposed buttresses and deeply crevassed glacier. Layered vector contour adaptation of a photograph by Ben Tubby. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Makalu.jpg. License: CC BY 2.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0. Changes: sky removed, cropped, tonal contours traced, blue and white palette.
